integrity: All exact computations can be rerun from the included standalone Python verifier; the universal conclusions follow from the explicit algebraic proof, not finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple complete bipartite networks, independent synchronous tie-only randomization with a single constant blue-bias per side and fixed initial colorings. No asserted extension to incomplete bipartite graphs, asynchronous dynamics, or a sharp best possible time bound. Novelty is assessed against inspected sources but unindexed equivalents remain possible. Independent audit not performed.
title: Exact consensus and polarization laws for biased random-majority on bicliques
